characterId.description: Exact story-bible character id for this profile.

masterProfile.description: One flowing 150–220 word paragraph of observable, wardrobe-independent behavior. Aim for 150-220 words; the character budget above is what enforces it.

voicePrompt.description: Fixed one- or two-sentence vocal identity, reused verbatim whenever this character speaks.

objectiveEngine.description: The recurring objective-driven behavior engine, expressed in filmable terms.

physicalBaseline.description: Observable center of gravity, tempo, openness, breath and posture baseline.

eyeLife.description: Continuous gaze targeting, micro-saccades, blink quality, catchlights and eyes-leading-thought behavior.

trigger.description: The concrete situation that triggers the tic.

crackTrigger.description: The exact observable condition under which the mask cracks.

softeningTarget.description: Optional one person, animal or object that visibly softens the character.
